2607.08319.title: GitLake: Git-for-data for the agentic lakehouse
2607.08319.paper_summary: We present GitLake, a Git-for-data design for an agent-first lakehouse. The system lifts single-table Iceberg snapshots into lakehouse-wide commits, branches, and merges, letting agents work on isolated branches while humans review and publish changes. Pipelines run on temporary branches and publish through a final merge, so all outputs become visible atomically or none do. Finally, we report production lessons as well as correctness insights from a preliminary Alloy model of our core abstractions.
2607.08319.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 GitLake，一個針對代理優先的湖倉設計的 Git-for-data 系統。該系統將單表 Iceberg 快照提升為湖倉範圍內的提交、分支和合併，讓代理在隔離的分支上工作，同時人類審核和發布變更。管道在臨時分支上運行，並通過最終合併發布，因此所有輸出要麼原子性可見，要麼都不可見。最後，我們報告了生產經驗教訓以及來自我們核心抽象的初步 Alloy 模型的正確性見解。
2607.08319.author: Weiming Sheng et.al.
